desc: Derive and prove the marginal-threshold algorithm: per-product count/cost, largest feasible threshold, and exact boundary-unit leftover handling.
Design an overflow-safe feasibility/count computation for a binary-search threshold up to approximately 2M.
Implement the algorithm in Python with O(N log M) complexity and stdin/stdout handling.
Check edge cases including one product, insufficient budget for any unit, and many equal marginal costs.
